s0001.literal: In the seventeenth year, spring, first month, on the guimao new moon, King Wang Chun of Goryeo dispatched his Privy Council associate director Kim Panggyŏng to offer congratulations and also present the annual tribute.
s0001.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, on the guimao new moon of the first month of spring, King Wang Chun of Goryeo sent his privy council associate director Kim Panggyŏng to offer congratulations and present the annual tribute.

s0002.literal: On bingwu day wanhu Qi Gongzhi was ordered to garrison Bie Shibali and granted twelve thousand five hundred ingots of paper currency.
s0002.idiomatic: On bingwu day wanhu Qi Gongzhi was ordered to garrison Bie Shibali and granted 12,500 ingots of paper currency.

s0003.literal: On xinhai day Cizhou and Yongping County suffered flooding; paper currency was issued as relief loans.
s0003.idiomatic: On xinhai day flooding struck Cizhou and Yongping County; paper currency was issued as relief loans.

s0004.literal: On bingchen day regulations for rotating officials were established: those without fault were appointed to open posts; where an incumbent had died or committed an offense, a selected person filled the post; those completing a term were ordered home to await reassignment.
s0004.idiomatic: On bingchen day regulations for rotating officials were established: the blameless received open appointments; deaths and offenses were filled by selected replacements; those completing a term went home to await reassignment.

s0005.literal: Tax levies and revenue quotas for all routes were also fixed: increases were to be reported immediately; concealment was punishable; there was to be no field-by-field tax increase to disturb the people.
s0005.idiomatic: Tax levies and revenue quotas for all routes were also fixed: increases had to be reported at once, concealment was punishable, and field-by-field tax hikes to disturb the people were forbidden.

s0006.literal: An edict ordered the registration of Jianghuai copper, copper cash, and copper vessels.
s0006.idiomatic: An edict ordered the registration of Jianghuai copper, copper cash, and copper vessels.

s0007.literal: On xinyou day more than one hundred thirty respectable women seized by the sea bandit He Wenda were returned to their families.
s0007.idiomatic: On xinyou day more than 130 respectable women seized by the sea bandit He Wenda were returned to their families.

s0008.literal: The Lianzhou sea bandits of Guangxi, Huo Gongming, Zheng Zhonglong, and others, were executed.
s0008.idiomatic: The Lianzhou sea bandits of Guangxi, Huo Gongming, Zheng Zhonglong, and others, were executed.

s0009.literal: On jiazi day an order directed that among the prefectures, districts, mountains, and stockades under the Quanzhou branch secretariat, any not yet submitted were to be taken by force; any taken and then rebelled again were to be put to the sword.
s0009.idiomatic: On jiazi day an order directed that among the prefectures, districts, mountains, and stockades under the Quanzhou branch secretariat, any not yet submitted were to be taken by force and any that rebelled after submission were to be put to the sword.

s0010.literal: Because commander-in-chief Zhang Xuan and qianhu Luo Bi had merit in taking the two Song princes, Xuan was promoted to coastal pacification commissioner with a tiger tally;
s0010.idiomatic: Because commander-in-chief Zhang Xuan and qianhu Luo Bi had merit in taking the two Song princes, Xuan was promoted to coastal pacification commissioner with a tiger tally;

s0011.literal: Bi was made army commander-in-chief with a gold tally.
s0011.idiomatic: Bi was made army commander-in-chief with a gold tally.

s0012.literal: On dingmao day the Emperor hunted in the near suburbs.
s0012.idiomatic: On dingmao day the Emperor hunted near the capital.

s0013.literal: An edict forbade employing palace guard troops as craftsman corvée.
s0013.idiomatic: An edict forbade employing palace guard troops as craftsman corvée.

s0014.literal: On wuchen day an order directed Xiangwei to examine the more than thirty-two thousand male captives taken by Ala Haiya, Qutuq Temür, and others, and release them all as civilians.
s0014.idiomatic: On wuchen day an order directed Xiangwei to examine the more than 32,000 male captives taken by Ala Haiya, Qutuq Temür, and others and release them all as civilians.

s0015.literal: A branch secretariat was established at Fuzhou.
s0015.idiomatic: A branch secretariat was established at Fuzhou.

s0016.literal: Deqing Route was changed to a commander-in-chief's headquarters.
s0016.idiomatic: Deqing Route was changed to a commander-in-chief's headquarters.

s0017.literal: Paper currency was granted to the five guard armies of the Kai-Luan River region.
s0017.idiomatic: Paper currency was granted to the five guard armies of the Kai-Luan River region.

s0018.literal: Second month, on yihai day, Zhang Yi said: "Gao Heshang has secret arts and can command ghosts as soldiers to control enemies from afar.
s0018.idiomatic: In the second month, on yihai day, Zhang Yi said, "Gao Heshang has secret arts and can command ghosts as soldiers to control enemies from afar.

s0019.literal: " Huluhuosun was ordered to lead troops together with Gao Heshang to the northern frontier.
s0019.idiomatic: " Huluhuosun was ordered to lead troops with Gao Heshang to the northern frontier.

s0020.literal: On bingzi day two relay stations were established on the Beijing circuit.
s0020.idiomatic: On bingzi day two relay stations were established on the Beijing circuit.

s0021.literal: On dingchou day Dalaibuhun led Yunnan branch secretariat troops to attack Dingchang Route, captured route commander-in-chief Gu Na, and killed him.
s0021.idiomatic: On dingchou day Dalaibuhun led Yunnan branch secretariat troops against Dingchang Route, captured route commander-in-chief Gu Na, and killed him.

s0022.literal: An edict ordered Dalaibuhun to return and replaced him with Ata.
s0022.idiomatic: An edict ordered Dalaibuhun to return and replaced him with Ata.

s0023.literal: An order forbade persons from recently submitted places who were not from distant regions to enter the Hall of Reunion.
s0023.idiomatic: An order forbade persons from recently submitted places who were not from distant regions to enter the Hall of Reunion.

s0024.literal: An edict ordered Nasir al-Din to lead ten thousand picked troops against Burma.
s0024.idiomatic: An edict ordered Nasir al-Din to lead 10,000 picked troops against Burma.

s0025.literal: On yiyou day five thousand three hundred twenty taels of silver were granted to reward Nasir al-Din's command for merit in the campaign against Jinch'i.
s0025.idiomatic: On yiyou day 5,320 taels of silver were granted to reward Nasir al-Din's command for merit in the campaign against Jinch'i.

s0026.literal: On jichou day Mei Guobin was ordered to inherit his father Yingchun's post as Luzhou pacification commissioner.
s0026.idiomatic: On jichou day Mei Guobin was ordered to inherit his father Yingchun's post as Luzhou pacification commissioner.

s0027.literal: Luzhou had once rebelled; Yingchun was killed by the former Chongqing military commissioner Zhang Jue.
s0027.idiomatic: Luzhou had once rebelled; Yingchun was killed by the former Chongqing military commissioner Zhang Jue.

s0028.literal: Guobin came to court to plead his grievance; an edict handed Jue over to Guobin and let him avenge his father.
s0028.idiomatic: Guobin came to court to plead his grievance; an edict handed Jue over to Guobin and let him avenge his father.

s0029.literal: Jue was then at Jingzhao; on hearing this he hanged himself.
s0029.idiomatic: Jue was then at Jingzhao; on hearing this he hanged himself.

s0030.literal: Guobin requested redemption of Luzhou soldiers and civilians held captive; granted.
s0030.idiomatic: Guobin asked to redeem Luzhou soldiers and civilians held captive; the request was granted.

s0031.literal: Japan had killed the envoy Du Shizhong and others; Eastern Campaign marshal Xindu and Hong Chajiu asked to lead troops themselves to punish them; court deliberation decided to defer the matter for the moment.
s0031.idiomatic: Japan had killed the envoy Du Shizhong and others; Eastern Campaign marshal Xindu and Hong Chajiu asked to lead troops themselves to punish them, but court deliberation decided to defer the matter for the moment.

s0032.literal: On bingshen day an edict instructed Perfect Man Qi Zhicheng and others to burn spurious passages in the 《Daoist Canon》 and the blocks used to print them.
s0032.idiomatic: On bingshen day an edict instructed Perfect Man Qi Zhicheng and others to burn spurious passages in the 《Daoist Canon》 and the blocks used to print them.

s0033.literal: On gengzi day Ala Haiya and Nasir al-Din recruited Burma and cave-man tribes to submit; an edict ordered their merits to be recorded and reported at the army front.
s0033.idiomatic: On gengzi day Ala Haiya and Nasir al-Din recruited Burma and cave-man tribes to submit; an edict ordered their merits recorded and reported at the army front.

s0034.literal: Huai-Jiang branch secretariat left associate Xia Gui requested retirement; granted, and his sons and grandsons were given office.
s0034.idiomatic: Huai-Jiang branch secretariat left associate Xia Gui requested retirement; the request was granted, and his sons and grandsons were given office.

s0035.literal: For Qara's command and cities such as He Prefecture that had been plundered by rebel troops, paper currency was granted for relief, and the people's corvée was remitted for three years.
s0035.idiomatic: For Qara's command and cities such as He Prefecture that rebel troops had plundered, paper currency was granted for relief and the people's corvée was remitted for three years.

s0036.literal: Three thousand palace guard troops were dispatched to dredge Tongzhou's grain transport canal.
s0036.idiomatic: Three thousand palace guard troops were dispatched to dredge Tongzhou's grain transport canal.

s0037.literal: Uyghur households dwelling on the Hexi frontier were ordered to garrison-farm.
s0037.idiomatic: Uyghur households dwelling on the Hexi frontier were ordered to garrison-farm.

s0038.literal: On xinchou day, because the people of Guangzhong could not make a living, right associate Tachu and left associate Lu Shikui were summoned to court to answer for harming the people; Yeshimishi and Jia Juzhen were ordered to proceed as branch pacification commissioners to soothe the region.
s0038.idiomatic: On xinchou day, because the people of Guangzhong could not make a living, right associate Tachu and left associate Lu Shikui were summoned to court to answer for harming the people; Yeshimishi and Jia Juzhen were ordered out as branch pacification commissioners to soothe the region.

s0039.literal: When Shikui arrived, court debate found no proof; he was ordered back to the secretariat to manage affairs.
s0039.idiomatic: When Shikui arrived, court debate found no proof, and he was ordered back to the secretariat to manage affairs.

s0040.literal: An edict directed princely chancellor's offices to purchase twenty-six thousand three hundred horses at the various ordu.
s0040.idiomatic: An edict directed princely chancellor's offices to purchase 26,300 horses at the various ordu.

s0041.literal: Envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at the mountains and rivers in the Emperor's stead.
s0041.idiomatic: Envoys were sent to sacrifice at the mountains and rivers in the Emperor's stead.

s0042.literal: The households under Princes Abaqa and Namukan, and Fan Wenhu and Alaghan of the Japan campaign branch secretariat, were granted Western brocade robes, silver, paper currency, and silks in graded amounts.
s0042.idiomatic: The households under Princes Abaqa and Namukan, and Fan Wenhu and Alaghan of the Japan campaign branch secretariat, received Western brocade robes, silver, paper currency, and silks in graded amounts.

s0043.literal: Paper currency was also granted to Sichuan's poor and for the price of horses, cattle, and sheep to Ulatai and others.
s0043.idiomatic: Paper currency was also granted to Sichuan's poor and for the price of horses, cattle, and sheep to Ulatai and others.

s0044.literal: Third month, on guimao day, Wang Jinweng of Fujian was ordered to enter and take charge of branch secretariat affairs; Central Secretariat officials held this improper, and he was changed to minister of revenue.
s0044.idiomatic: In the third month, on guimao day, Wang Jinweng of Fujian was ordered to take charge of branch secretariat affairs; Central Secretariat officials held this improper, and he was made minister of revenue instead.

s0045.literal: On jiachen day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.
s0045.idiomatic: On jiachen day the Emperor proceeded to Shangdu.

s0046.literal: Troops of Si and Bozhou encroached on the borders of Zhenyuan and Huangping; Li Dehui and others were ordered to go and inspect.
s0046.idiomatic: Troops of Si and Bozhou encroached on the borders of Zhenyuan and Huangping; Li Dehui and others were ordered to go and inspect.

s0047.literal: Incompetent officials of the Communications Bureau were dismissed.
s0047.idiomatic: Incompetent officials of the Communications Bureau were dismissed.

s0048.literal: On bingwu day an order directed Eastern and Western Sichuan to dispatch Mongol and Han troops to garrison Yutong, Li, and Ya.
s0048.idiomatic: On bingwu day an order directed Eastern and Western Sichuan to dispatch Mongol and Han troops to garrison Yutong, Li, and Ya.

s0049.literal: On yimao day the Directorate of Merit Commissions was established, ranked 2b, in charge of memorializing on Buddhist clergy under the Imperial Preceptor and Tibetan military and civilians.
s0049.idiomatic: On yimao day the Directorate of Merit Commissions was established at rank 2b, in charge of memorializing on Buddhist clergy under the Imperial Preceptor and Tibetan military and civilians.

s0050.literal: On jiwei day an edict ordered a campaign against the Luoshi Ghost Country; six thousand Mongol troops, ten thousand Qara Jang troops, ten thousand troops under Yarlaq Hai and Wanjianu of Western Sichuan, and ten thousand troops under Ala Haiya were to advance on three routes together.
s0050.idiomatic: On jiwei day an edict ordered a campaign against the Luoshi Ghost Country; 6,000 Mongol troops, 10,000 Qara Jang troops, 10,000 troops under Yarlaq Hai and Wanjianu of Western Sichuan, and 10,000 troops under Ala Haiya were to advance on three routes together.

s0051.literal: On guihai day Gaoyou and other places suffered famine; nine thousand four hundred shi of grain were issued for relief.
s0051.idiomatic: On guihai day Gaoyou and other places suffered famine; 9,400 shi of grain were issued for relief.

s0052.literal: On xinwei day an exchange-note superintendency was established within Uyghur territory.
s0052.idiomatic: On xinwei day an exchange-note superintendency was established within Uyghur territory.

s0053.literal: Plough ox teams were supplied to Tutghus's eight tribes for garrison farming.
s0053.idiomatic: Plough ox teams were supplied to Tutghus's eight tribes for garrison farming.

s0054.literal: Sheep and horses were granted to Mangudai and others, and price payments for sheep and horses to Prince Namuqa's household.
s0054.idiomatic: Sheep and horses were granted to Mangudai and others, and price payments for sheep and horses to Prince Namuqa's household.

s0055.literal: Summer, fourth month, on the renshen new moon, Central Secretariat officials said: "Suodu's soldiers disturbed the people, so the people of Nanjian and other routes rebelled again.
s0055.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on the renshen new moon, Central Secretariat officials said, "Suodu's soldiers disturbed the people, so the people of Nanjian and other routes rebelled again.

s0056.literal: Only when Mangudai went to win them over did the people at last find peace.
s0056.idiomatic: Only when Mangudai went to win them over did the people at last find peace.

s0057.literal: " An edict ordered Mangudai to continue administering the branch secretariat at Fuzhou.
s0057.idiomatic: " An edict ordered Mangudai to continue administering the branch secretariat at Fuzhou.

s0058.literal: On renyou day Du Keyong of Nankang rebelled; Shi Bi was ordered to campaign against him and capture him.
s0058.idiomatic: On renyou day Du Keyong of Nankang rebelled; Shi Bi was ordered to campaign against him and capture him.

s0059.literal: The Hangzhou pacification commission was fixed at four officials, with You Xian, Guan Rude, Huduhu, and Liu Xuan appointed.
s0059.idiomatic: The Hangzhou pacification commission was fixed at four officials, with You Xian, Guan Rude, Huduhu, and Liu Xuan appointed.

s0060.literal: On bingzi day Yangmen Station of Longxing Route was again made Huai'an County.
s0060.idiomatic: On bingzi day Yangmen Station of Longxing Route was again made Huai'an County.

s0061.literal: On gengchen day Sichuan pacification commissioner Yehandejin requested grant of a gyrfalcon tally; an order directed that two tallies be given him.
s0061.idiomatic: On gengchen day Sichuan pacification commissioner Yehandejin requested a gyrfalcon tally; an order directed that two tallies be given him.

s0062.literal: On renwu day Shi Bi came to court.
s0062.idiomatic: On renwu day Shi Bi came to court.

s0063.literal: On yiyou day Song's court music was handed over to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
s0063.idiomatic: On yiyou day Song's court music was handed over to the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

s0064.literal: Lingbi County of Sizhou was again placed under Suzhou.
s0064.idiomatic: Lingbi County of Sizhou was again placed under Suzhou.

s0065.literal: On dinghai day the Hangzhou Route gold and jade commander-in-chief's headquarters was established.
s0065.idiomatic: On dinghai day the Hangzhou Route gold and jade commander-in-chief's headquarters was established.

s0066.literal: On jiawu day impoverished soldier households were restored to civilian registers.
s0066.idiomatic: On jiawu day impoverished soldier households were restored to civilian registers.

s0067.literal: On bingshen day, because the Luozuo Mountain route was blocked, an order directed Ala Haiya to dispatch one thousand troops to garrison it.
s0067.idiomatic: On bingshen day, because the Luozuo Mountain route was blocked, an order directed Ala Haiya to dispatch 1,000 troops to garrison it.

s0068.literal: Because placing three branch secretariats at Longxing, Quanzhou, and Fujian was inconvenient, court officials were ordered to assemble and deliberate and report.
s0068.idiomatic: Because placing three branch secretariats at Longxing, Quanzhou, and Fujian was inconvenient, court officials were ordered to assemble, deliberate, and report.

s0069.literal: On jihai day Prince Jibeq Temür requested that each appanage establish officials; not granted.
s0069.idiomatic: On jihai day Prince Jibeq Temür requested that each appanage establish officials; the request was denied.

s0070.literal: On gengzi day Jupiter transgressed the Great Star of Xuanyuan.
s0070.idiomatic: On gengzi day Jupiter transgressed the Great Star of Xuanyuan.

s0071.literal: An order temporarily suspended official salaries.
s0071.idiomatic: An order temporarily suspended official salaries.

s0072.literal: Frost struck four commanderies including Ninghai and Yidu; insects struck seven commanderies of Zhending; all damaged mulberry.
s0072.idiomatic: Frost struck four commanderies including Ninghai and Yidu; insects struck seven commanderies of Zhending; all damaged mulberry.

s0073.literal: Fifth month, on the xinchou new moon, the Privy Council transferred six hundred troops to garrison the south and north passes of Juyong.
s0073.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the xinchou new moon, the Privy Council transferred 600 troops to garrison the south and north passes of Juyong.

s0074.literal: On jiachen day a traveling palace was built at Chaghan Na'ur.
s0074.idiomatic: On jiachen day a traveling palace was built at Chaghan Na'ur.

s0075.literal: On bingwu day Shazhou was promoted to a route.
s0075.idiomatic: On bingwu day Shazhou was promoted to a route.

s0076.literal: On guichou day Shazhou household males were registered and regular levies fixed; surplus fields of wealthy households were ordered given to garrison Han troops to cultivate.
s0076.idiomatic: On guichou day Shazhou household males were registered and regular levies fixed; surplus fields of wealthy households were ordered given to garrison Han troops to cultivate.

s0077.literal: An edict ordered the Yunnan branch secretariat to dispatch ten thousand Sichuan troops, placed under Yarlaq Hai's command, to campaign against Burma together with the generals previously sent.
s0077.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Yunnan branch secretariat to dispatch 10,000 Sichuan troops under Yarlaq Hai to campaign against Burma together with the generals previously sent.

s0078.literal: King Wang Chun of Goryeo, because his people suffered famine, requested a loan of ten thousand shi of grain; granted.
s0078.idiomatic: King Wang Chun of Goryeo, because his people suffered famine, requested a loan of 10,000 shi of grain; the request was granted.

s0079.literal: The Fujian branch secretariat moved to Quanzhou.
s0079.idiomatic: The Fujian branch secretariat moved to Quanzhou.

s0080.literal: On jiayin day the Ting and Zhang rebels Liao Desheng and others were executed.
s0080.idiomatic: On jiayin day the Ting and Zhang rebels Liao Desheng and others were executed.

s0081.literal: Three thousand ships were to be built; an order directed Tamna to supply timber.
s0081.idiomatic: Three thousand ships were to be built; an order directed Tamna to supply timber.

s0082.literal: On gengshen day Prince Beg Temür was granted a silver seal.
s0082.idiomatic: On gengshen day Prince Beg Temür was granted a silver seal.

s0083.literal: On xinyou day the Imperial Preceptor's teaching office was granted a seal.
s0083.idiomatic: On xinyou day the Imperial Preceptor's teaching office was granted a seal.

s0084.literal: Twenty-eight thousand seven hundred fifty taels of silver were granted to reward the battle merit of Bayan's officers and soldiers.
s0084.idiomatic: 28,750 taels of silver were granted to reward the battle merit of Bayan's officers and soldiers.

s0085.literal: Locusts struck the prefectures and commanderies of Zhending, Xianping, Xin Prefecture, Lian, Hai, Pi, and Su.
s0085.idiomatic: Locusts struck the prefectures and commanderies of Zhending, Xianping, Xin Prefecture, Lian, Hai, Pi, and Su.

s0086.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on the xinchou new moon, Guangdong pacification commissioner Tiemur Buqa said: "Military officers should all rotate by a single rule.
s0086.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on the xinchou new moon, Guangdong pacification commissioner Tiemur Buqa said, "Military officers should all rotate by a single rule.

s0087.literal: In Huai-Jiang prefectures and counties, the chief instigators of disorder were to be executed and their households confiscated.
s0087.idiomatic: In Huai-Jiang prefectures and counties, the chief instigators of disorder were to be executed and their households confiscated.

s0088.literal: Officials and powerful families who concealed tenant commoners and did not supply corvée should have separate registers established.
s0088.idiomatic: Officials and powerful families who concealed tenant commoners and did not supply corvée should have separate registers established.

s0089.literal: Household troops of the various wanhu who were mixed in heavy corvée should be sent back to their original wings.
s0089.idiomatic: Household troops of the various wanhu who were mixed in heavy corvée should be sent back to their original wings.

s0090.literal: " An edict ordered the Central Secretariat, Privy Council, and Hanlin Academy to assemble and deliberate and report.
s0090.idiomatic: " An edict ordered the Central Secretariat, Privy Council, and Hanlin Academy to assemble, deliberate, and report.

s0091.literal: An order directed the Si Prefecture pacification commission to return to its former seat.
s0091.idiomatic: An order directed the Si Prefecture pacification commission to return to its former seat.

s0092.literal: On wushen day the moon transgressed the Determining Star of Fang.
s0092.idiomatic: On wushen day the moon transgressed the Determining Star of Fang.

s0093.literal: Because Goryeo had first established relay stations and relay households lacked food, an order directed that grain be supplied for one year and envoys forbidden to come and go demanding food and drink.
s0093.idiomatic: Because Goryeo had first established relay stations and relay households lacked food, an order directed grain supplied for one year and forbade envoys to come and go demanding food and drink.

s0094.literal: On jiyou day a branch secretariat was established at Jingzhao, with the former Anxi chancellor Li Dehui as associate administrator concurrently in charge of revenue and grain.
s0094.idiomatic: On jiyou day a branch secretariat was established at Jingzhao, with the former Anxi chancellor Li Dehui as associate administrator concurrently in charge of revenue and grain.

s0095.literal: The Quanzhou branch secretariat moved to Longxing.
s0095.idiomatic: The Quanzhou branch secretariat moved to Longxing.

s0096.literal: Because Tuganem's troops had plundered grain in the Huozhuo Uyghur city, and the people suffered famine, an order directed that relay-horse expenses be supplied by the state and their taxes remitted for three years.
s0096.idiomatic: Because Tuganem's troops had plundered grain in the Huozhuo Uyghur city and the people suffered famine, an order directed that relay-horse expenses be supplied by the state and their taxes remitted for three years.

s0097.literal: The moon transgressed the Southern Dipper.
s0097.idiomatic: The moon transgressed the Southern Dipper.

s0098.literal: On jiayin day eight hundred guard troops were dispatched to repair Shaling Bridge; an order forbade trampling civilian fields.
s0098.idiomatic: On jiayin day 800 guard troops were dispatched to repair Shaling Bridge; an order forbade trampling civilian fields.

s0099.literal: On wuwu day, following Ahmad's recommendation, associate administrators Hao Zhen and Geng Ren were both made left vice chancellors of the Central Secretariat;
s0099.idiomatic: On wuwu day, following Ahmad's recommendation, associate administrators Hao Zhen and Geng Ren were both made left vice chancellors of the Central Secretariat;

s0100.literal: At Yao Yan's recommendation, the Jiaodong canal was opened and fugitive commoners were gathered for garrison farming at Lian and Hai.
s0100.idiomatic: At Yao Yan's recommendation, the Jiaodong canal was opened and fugitive commoners were gathered for garrison farming at Lian and Hai.
